title: Allowed long code weighted experiment
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a sign tester have a finite seed set and a probability law, and let $[?]$ be a finite set of sign predicates. Suppose every check selected by the tester uses a predicate in this set. The associated weighted constraint experiment has as outcomes the long code experiment samples, distributed according to the experiment law; each outcome selects its check's predicate, and its ordered scope is the tuple of long code experiment variables at the check's input positions.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A sign tester with a finite seed set and a probability law
A finite set of sign predicates
Every tester check uses a predicate in the specified set
caveat: The predicate set is denoted by an unnamed set in the statement; the intended notation is a finite set of sign predicates.
